questions.question_text: A 5 ohm resistor and a 10 ohm resistor are in series across a 30 V source. What potential difference is across the 5 ohm resistor?
questions.explanation: The total resistance is 15 ohm, so current is 2 A. The 5 ohm resistor has V = IR = 10 V.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual verification: NCERT Physics and Science textbooks, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: A submerged block displaces 0.003 m^3 of water. Taking water density as 1000 kg/m^3 and g as 10 m/s^2, what is the buoyant force?
questions.explanation: Buoyant force equals the weight of displaced water: rho V g = 1000 x 0.003 x 10 = 30 N.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual verification: NCERT Physics and Science textbooks, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php
